title: Technical Validation Paths
body: Choosing between a custom demo, Glean Lab, sandbox and pilot/PoC; pilot gating, readiness scoring, and approval
kicker: 6 lessons · knowledge check at the end of this page
list_label: By the end of this module you can:
list: Compare custom demo, Glean Lab, sandbox and pilot on data, prep, duration and cost.
Default to the lightest validation that proves value.
Apply the pilot entry criteria and readiness scorecard.
Frame a sandbox correctly with the champion.
footnote: Recommended before this module: SBP-109. Prerequisites are proposed; roadmap mappings are alignment only, not equivalency.
